final.summary: The ETP stopped for about two and three-quarter hours midday, but the equalization tank rose while outfall flow stayed at zero and outfall pH stayed near neutral. After restart power matched the load-expected band and the power feed was not a replay, showing working treatment for the batch water.

key_evidence.why: Power at standby level shows ETP stopped over the maintenance window.
Tank level rose while ETP was at standby, showing water was held.
Zero outfall flow during the stop shows nothing passed the outfall meter.
Outfall pH stayed near neutral with no reading above 9, showing no raw wastewater reached the outfall.
Power matched the load-expected band, showing aeration ran when flow passed through.
Power feed did not repeat another day, so it can be relied on for that stretch.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 10:00 to 2026-10-14 14:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: S2 and S4a were flat at zero during the stop; this is expected for a stopped feed and zero discharge, not treated as a fault.
Tank balance over the stop showed unaccounted water; this is within the estimation uncertainty of arriving volume from intake and does not show a bypass.
Outfall conductivity over the full interval was not retrieved within the check budget, so dilution by conductivity drop cannot be checked; pH and flow still show no bypass.
Lab sample at 11:20 was taken just before the stop and does not represent treatment during the stop itself.
Factory logbook and maintenance record are claims checked against signals, not facts.
